atlas_config.description: Second bounded adaptive sampled-path-gap atlas. It reuses integrity-checked M20 observations from the completed v1 atlas, adds target-contour samples, and constrains visible surrogate overshoot. The processed COMSOL data remains a reference-only layer.
atlas_config.scope: Exploratory M20 sampled-path-gap mapping. Every third new point is selected to constrain values that leave the observed PWE range; the remaining points refine prescribed target contours. This contour map is neither an M25 validation nor a full-Brillouin-zone or continuum certificate.

effective_forward_config.description: Preregistered implementation-only anchor-free mathematical inverse prototype. Do not launch PWE searches until the explicit audit gate is reviewed.
effective_forward_config.geometry: para: fixed-center oppositely oriented disk-clipped equilateral triangles
effective_forward_config.projector: fixed homothetic radial extension, direct Fourier quadrature
final_refinement_checks: Report whether abs(G20-target)+abs(G25-G20) is within the unchanged existing final tolerance.
M25 is an independent check of the same geometry, not a correction fitted to the target or any COMSOL result.
A two-cutoff agreement is an empirical check, not a certified continuum error bound.
effective_forward_config.gradient_reliability_policy: Reliable only after the caller checks simple edge modes, active-k uniqueness or justified equal edge sensitivities, and finite analytic gradients; otherwise bounded coordinate polling.
